name: s81_rly_66_sw

job.purpose: S81 c26l die relay master dsfd_rly_66_SW: stand-in with no closed view in the c26l census; real hard tile cloned from the closed sibling s81_rly_66_ws recipe: 66 b in S / out W, ck+rs N, one register stage, reset pin register (RSREG=1)

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_rly_66_SW u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_c26l.sv && echo lint-ok

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 opt-out (coordinator APPROVED 2026-10-15): this relay IS one flip-flop per bit between its input and output pins (ot_s81_rly: i -> r -> o, no logic); a flow pin register would add a second stage per bit and a cycle the die calendar does not price

structural_change: c26l fill (S-ELEM 2026-10-16 18:xx): new master dsfd_rly_66_SW cloned from closed s81_rly_66_ws (same outline 17.256x17.256, same route recipe, RSREG=1); only data/clock faces differ. 0 cycles (one relay register stage as every relay).
